note: Discrete chemistry hazards for a still-solid batch cell: carbonate decomposition only. A solid cell cannot fuse, so it emits no fusion hazard at all. Hazards are per-call probabilities the engine clamps to [0,1]; below the inferred onset they go negative and are clamped to zero, which is what keeps chemistry off in a cold cell. Hand-authored illustrative map: it demonstrates the mechanism (Geant4 material facts -> conditions -> per-material operators) and carries no measured training domain, no scale band and no held-out accuracy (measured:false, teacher:none). The declared input mean/std are the intended operating range, so a run far outside it is honestly flagged as extrapolating; they are NOT a measured hull. It must never be described as glass-making metrology.
